expectations.text: 全球或混合赛道开启海外景气支柱，本土赛道关闭且不受惩罚
expectations.evidence: Substantive evidence appears in both artifacts. report.html classifies AI算力 as 混合定价 with ‘O 开启’, 铜 as 全球定价 with ‘O 开启’, and 国产软件 as 本土定价 with ‘O 关闭’ and ‘O=N/A（不计分、不扣分）’. The ledger independently records pricingScope mixed/global/domestic and overseasGate on/on/off; the domestic software overseasCycle pillar is inactive with null score and evidence stating ‘不计分、不扣分’.

expectations.text: AI算力在估值闸门未通过时不输出允许重仓主线核心
expectations.evidence: report.html explicitly says ‘AI算力估值闸门为 fail；不得输出“允许重仓主线核心”’ and gives permission ‘共振成立但重仓权限待执行闸门确认’. The ledger's falseThemeFilter says the fail keeps heavy-position permission closed, its upgrade trigger requires valuation to turn pass, and coreStocks is empty.

expectations.text: 铜因定向信贷或产业投入缺失而被评级/权限封顶
expectations.evidence: report.html assigns 铜 19.8/C, ‘单因子脉冲’, and ‘禁止重仓，仅观察脉冲；C 未确认形成硬封顶’. The ledger records directedCredit confirmed=false and states that unconfirmed directed credit/industrial investment makes the false-theme filter fail; heavyPositionPermission is ‘禁止重仓，仅观察脉冲’. This establishes the required causal cap, not merely a low label.

expectations.text: 国产软件的长线资金流出被当作反证而非中性
expectations.evidence: report.html says ‘L 恶化是反证，不按中性计’ and describes institutional outflow as strength 2, worsening, confidence 0.80, ‘为反证’. The ledger sets longTermCapital marginal=-1 and confirmed=false, and its counterEvidence says the outflow directly negates current long-term-capital confirmation.

expectations.text: 报告明确说明多支柱是不同证伪职责而非简单利好相加
expectations.evidence: report.html contains a dedicated section titled ‘为什么不能把“政策 + 资金 + 景气”简单相加’, separately defines what P, C, L, and O answer, and concludes ‘四支柱承担不同证伪职责，硬闸门优先于总分’. The explanation includes concrete veto behavior for missing C, negative L, and failed valuation rather than just repeating the assertion's keywords.

expectations.text: 机器台账使用alpha.mainline_trend.v1结构，并与报告的海外开关、共振状态和权限一致
expectations.evidence: The ledger declares schema='alpha.mainline_trend.v1'. Its AI/国产软件/铜 records match report.html on overseasGate (on/off/on), resonance (主升共振/部分共振/单因子脉冲), and permission (待执行闸门确认/轻仓验证/禁止重仓仅观察脉冲).

expectations.text: 所有假设证据在报告和台账中标记为测试数据，且没有伪造外部引用
expectations.evidence: report.html prominently declares the structure-test scope and labels each evidence row ‘[测试数据]’. Every ledger evidence item is marked ‘测试数据｜无外部引用’, sources is empty, and inspection found no external URL in the report or ledger.

claims.claim: Only supplied hypothetical data was used and no external sources were represented as evidence.
claims.evidence: The report prominently labels the work a structure test and marks factual evidence as 测试数据; the ledger prefixes every evidence item with 测试数据/无外部引用 and has sources=[]. The transcript records no networking, and no external URL appears in the inspected report or ledger.
